transcript: This past weekend, my boyfriend Paul and I saw A Rough Trade at The Tank, a new play that takes a close look at the relationships of 4 gay men in New York City. Each character is somewhat of a gay archetype, and the play shows both codependency among them as well as some of the more toxic aspects of the gay community. There are some scathing arguments where classism, stereotyping, and intellectual elitism are all at play, and I think the show does a good job of showing the nuances of navigating a chosen family where everyone can be deeply fond of one another but still complicit in the toxicity. With that, another program for my collection.
